evals.prompt: Verify our active local `docker-desktop` Kubernetes context and server capabilities first, then run a comprehensive OpenTelemetry security posture audit across the `otel-demo` namespace covering collectors, instrumentation CRs, eBPF pods, and RBAC roles, and render an executive Markdown compliance report.
evals.expected_output: Reads `otel://cluster/contexts` (confirming `docker-desktop`) and `otel://server/capabilities` via OpenTelemetry MCP resources without invoking raw `kubectl` CLI commands, calls `otel_audit_security_posture(namespace="otel-demo", scope=["collectors", "instrumentation", "ebpf", "rbac"])`, saves the audit JSON and runs `scripts/render_audit_report.py --input ...` to produce a structured Markdown compliance report (`COMPLIANT` vs `NON-COMPLIANT` badge, audited counts, risk level, and prioritized remediation table).
expectations: Verifies the active `docker-desktop` context and server capabilities via `otel://cluster/contexts` and `otel://server/capabilities` without invoking raw `kubectl` CLI commands
Calls `otel_audit_security_posture` for `otel-demo` across `collectors`, `instrumentation`, `ebpf`, and `rbac`
Runs `scripts/render_audit_report.py` and outputs a structured Markdown compliance report with risk level, audited counts, and categorized findings

evals.prompt: Scan our collectors in `otel-demo` (`otel-insecure-collector`) for hardcoded bearer tokens or API keys in exporter headers, and preview remediating them safely using Kubernetes `Secret` `otel-demo-telemetry-secrets` (`secretKeyRef` key `auth-token`) and `${env:...}` variable expansion—never print any raw secret values or read `.env` files.
evals.expected_output: Calls `otel_audit_security_posture(namespace="otel-demo", scope=["collectors"])` (detecting inline credentials on `otel-insecure-collector`), honors `hooks/secret-safety.py` by never reading `.env` or dumping raw Kubernetes `Secret` payloads, configures `spec.env` with `valueFrom.secretKeyRef` (`name: otel-demo-telemetry-secrets`, `key: auth-token` -> `OTEL_EXPORTER_AUTH_TOKEN`) and replaces inline header credentials with `Authorization: "Bearer ${env:OTEL_EXPORTER_AUTH_TOKEN}"`, previewing via `otel_patch_collector(namespace="otel-demo", name="otel-insecure-collector", ..., dry_run=True)`.
expectations: Audits `otel-demo` collectors via `otel_audit_security_posture` without dumping Kubernetes `Secret` values or reading `.env` files
Replaces inline credentials with `${env:OTEL_EXPORTER_AUTH_TOKEN}` backed by Kubernetes `secretKeyRef` (`otel-demo-telemetry-secrets`)
Previews the hardened collector via `otel_patch_collector(..., dry_run=True)` without echoing plaintext tokens

evals.prompt:
Audit and preview hardening this external vendor exporter block on `otel-gateway` in `observability` (which forwards `otel-demo` telemetry off-cluster while also exporting internally to `tempo-distributor.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317`):
```yaml
exporters:
  otlphttp/cloud:
    endpoint: https://otlp-ingest.observability-cloud.io
    tls:
      insecure: true
      insecure_skip_verify: true
```
evals.expected_output: Flags both `tls.insecure: true` on an external `https://` endpoint and `tls.insecure_skip_verify: true` (MITM vulnerability), explains that `tls.insecure: true` is only acceptable on cluster-internal plaintext hops (`*.svc.cluster.local`), sets `tls: {insecure: false}` (with `ca_file` if private PKI is used) and removes `insecure_skip_verify`, previewing via `otel_patch_collector(..., dry_run=True)`.
expectations: Flags both `tls.insecure: true` on an external endpoint and `tls.insecure_skip_verify: true`
Distinguishes cluster-internal `*.svc.cluster.local` hops from external `https://` SaaS ingress
Previews hardened `tls: {insecure: false}` config on `otel-gateway` via `otel_patch_collector(..., dry_run=True)`

evals.prompt: Our security scanner flagged the OpenTelemetry eBPF (`obi`) DaemonSet in `otel-demo` (deployed to trace Rust `shipping` and C++ `currency` pods) for running with `securityContext.privileged: true` and `hostNetwork: true` on Linux kernel `6.1`. Audit it via MCP and provide a least-privilege Linux capabilities DaemonSet spec.
evals.expected_output: Calls `otel_audit_security_posture(namespace="otel-demo", scope=["ebpf"])` (flagging `privileged: true`), and replaces `privileged: true` and `hostNetwork: true` with `privileged: false`, `hostNetwork: false`, `hostPID: true`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, read-only `/sys/kernel/security` and `/sys/fs/cgroup` mounts, `capabilities.drop: ["ALL"]`, and `capabilities.add: ["BPF", "PERFMON", "SYS_PTRACE", "NET_RAW", "CHECKPOINT_RESTORE", "DAC_READ_SEARCH", "SYS_RESOURCE"]`.
expectations: Audits eBPF pods via `otel_audit_security_posture` and sets `privileged: false`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, and `hostNetwork: false` (`hostPID: true`)
Drops `ALL` Linux capabilities and adds only the minimal eBPF capability set (`BPF`, `PERFMON`, `SYS_PTRACE`, `NET_RAW`, `CHECKPOINT_RESTORE`, `DAC_READ_SEARCH`, `SYS_RESOURCE`)
Enforces `readOnly: true` on `/sys/kernel/security` and `/sys/fs/cgroup` volume mounts

evals.prompt: Audit the Kubernetes RBAC `ClusterRole` attached to `otel-insecure-collector` in `otel-demo` for excessive wildcard (`*`) or `secrets` read/write permissions, and generate a least-privilege `ClusterRole` for `k8sattributes` and `k8s_cluster` enriching `otel-demo` pods.
evals.expected_output: Calls `otel_audit_security_posture(namespace="otel-demo", scope=["rbac"])`, identifies wildcard `*` and `secrets` permissions on the collector `ClusterRole`, explains that OpenTelemetry Collectors only ever need read-only metadata access (`verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]`) and must never hold write verbs or `secrets` access, and outputs a hardened least-privilege `ClusterRole`.
expectations: Audits RBAC via `otel_audit_security_posture(namespace="otel-demo", scope=["rbac"])` and flags wildcard / `secrets` over-privilege
Restricts `ClusterRole` verbs strictly to `["get", "list", "watch"]` and removes `secrets` access
Preserves required Kubernetes workload/node metadata resources for `k8sattributes` and `k8s_cluster`

evals.prompt: Review `otel-insecure-collector` in `otel-demo`, which currently exposes `pprof` on `0.0.0.0:1777`, `zpages` on `0.0.0.0:55679`, and an unauthenticated externally reachable OTLP HTTP receiver on `0.0.0.0:4318` with wildcard CORS (`allowed_origins: ["*"]`) accepting browser RUM traces from `frontend`. Audit it and preview hardening the configuration.
evals.expected_output: Calls `otel_audit_security_posture(namespace="otel-demo", scope=["collectors"])`, flags `0.0.0.0` diagnostic exposure on `pprof` and `zpages`, binds `pprof` (`127.0.0.1:1777`) and `zpages` (`127.0.0.1:55679`) strictly to loopback (or disables them in prod), attaches an `oidc` or `bearertokenauth` authenticator extension + explicit origin allowlist (`cors.allowed_origins`) on externally exposed OTLP HTTP receivers, and previews via `otel_patch_collector(..., dry_run=True)`.
expectations: Rebinds `pprof` and `zpages` from `0.0.0.0` to `127.0.0.1` (or removes them in production)
Configures `oidc` or `bearertokenauth` authentication and explicit `cors.allowed_origins` (removing wildcard `*`) on externally exposed OTLP receivers
Previews the hardened config via `otel_patch_collector(..., dry_run=True)`

evals.prompt: We are enabling Kubernetes Pod Security Admission `restricted` enforcement on `otel-demo`, and our gateway collector pod (`opentelemetry-otel-collector`) currently runs without non-root user, capability drop, or `seccompProfile` settings. Preview hardening its pod and container `securityContext` so it passes `restricted` PSA cleanly.
evals.expected_output: Configures `runAsNonRoot: true`, `runAsUser: 10001`, `seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true`, and `capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"]}`, previewing via `otel_patch_collector(namespace="otel-demo", name="opentelemetry-otel-collector", workload_options=..., dry_run=True)` (or rendering the exact CRD `podSecurityContext`/`securityContext` patch).
expectations: Configures `runAsNonRoot: true`, `runAsUser: 10001`, and `seccompProfile.type: RuntimeDefault`
Sets `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true`, and `capabilities.drop: ["ALL"]`
Previews the hardened configuration via `otel_patch_collector(..., dry_run=True)`

evals.prompt: During a PCI-DSS & GDPR audit of `opentelemetry-otel-collector` in `otel-demo`, we discovered customer credit card PANs from `payment`, SSNs, order confirmation emails from `email`, and `Authorization`/`Cookie` headers from `frontend-proxy` flowing unredacted through `traces` and `logs`. Preview and apply collector-side PII scrubbing.
evals.expected_output: Calls `otel_configure_processing(namespace="otel-demo", collector_name="opentelemetry-otel-collector", signals=["traces", "logs"], rules={"mask_pii": ["credit_card", "ssn", "email", "bearer_token", "jwt"], "drop_attributes": ["http.request.header.authorization", "http.request.header.cookie", "http.response.header.set_cookie"]}, dry_run=True)`, verifies the diff, and applies with `dry_run=False`.
expectations: Calls `otel_configure_processing` on `opentelemetry-otel-collector` in `otel-demo` with `rules={"mask_pii": [...], "drop_attributes": [...]}` on `signals=["traces", "logs"]`
Scrubs PAN (`credit_card`), `ssn`, `email`, `bearer_token`/`jwt`, and sensitive auth/cookie headers
Runs `dry_run=True` first before applying `dry_run=False`

evals.prompt: Review our `filelog` log-collection DaemonSet `otel-insecure-agent` in `observability` (which tails container logs on nodes running `otel-demo` pods) for dangerous writable host filesystem mounts (`/var/log/pods` or `/hostfs` mounted read-write), and preview fixing the volume mounts without breaking `filelog` offset checkpointing.
evals.expected_output: Calls `otel_audit_security_posture(namespace="observability", scope=["collectors"])` (flagging writable `/var/log/pods` mount on `otel-insecure-agent`), explains that `/var/log/pods`, `/var/lib/docker/containers`, and `/hostfs` MUST be mounted `readOnly: true`, while only `/var/lib/otelcol/file_storage` (`DirectoryOrCreate`) remains writable for `file_storage` checkpoint persistence across restarts, previewing via `otel_patch_collector(namespace="observability", name="otel-insecure-agent", ..., dry_run=True)`.
expectations: Audits `observability` via `otel_audit_security_posture` and sets `readOnly: true` on `/var/log/pods` and `/hostfs` mounts
Preserves writable access exclusively on `/var/lib/otelcol/file_storage` (`DirectoryOrCreate`) so `filelog` offsets survive restarts
Previews the fix on `otel-insecure-agent` via `otel_patch_collector(..., dry_run=True)`
